title: Risk Register Entry
rationale: Retain generic documentary-entity context without importing case identity or cardinality rules. A register entry is a record about the analytical risk item, not another risk subject.
context_interpretation: R-01 targets one RiskCase in this profile and permits zero or many entries per case. R-33 relates distinct entry revisions to their entry; RX-008 assigns register membership. Neither an entry identifier nor organizational admission is the case's universal existence condition.

title: Risk Description
rationale: Retain describing motivation as related documentary-function context. The source term is a motivation instance, not a class equivalent to RiskDescription or its risk referent.
context_interpretation: RK2-007/RK2-008/R-37 preserve case, pattern and scenario targets; R-39 qualifies description function. C-09 requires a published description target under its profile. Source/description context does not establish an actual occurrence or turn the description into its case.

title: Consequence Statement
rationale: Retain descriptive-function context while separating a possible/reported consequence statement from an outcome. The motivation does not supply consequence semantics or establish realization.
context_interpretation: R-22 concerns the analytical RiskCase; R-40 retains a source slot and RX-010 permits no actual-outcome referent (0..1). A recorded possible consequence must not be promoted into an observed outcome merely to populate a field.

title: Identification Information
rationale: Retain attribution as a partial provenance comparison. Attribution of an identification document does not define the complete source/channel/participant/time record or mean that an agent created the RiskCase.
context_interpretation: R-07 identifies the analytical risk item, R-08 records actor references and R-27 records intake channels. R-52 connects the information to revisions. Documentary attribution is kept separate from actual risk causation, operational admission and available temporal precision.

title: Intake Channel Term
rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for an intake-channel value. The channel describes how information arrived; it is not a real-world contributor to risk or a universal channel taxonomy.
context_interpretation: The path through ClassificationTerm and VocabularyConcept preserves InformationArtifact identity. R-27 records a source-qualified channel; common text neither identifies the vocabulary resource nor resolves a risk source.

title: Description Role Term
rationale: Retain controlled vocabulary context for description function. Selecting a term such as title or summary does not itself create a description, a scenario or the described risk subject.
context_interpretation: R-39 supplies the selected function of a RiskDescription. Scheme-qualified term identity is inherited through ClassificationTerm/VocabularyConcept; retained groups remain incomplete and non-disjoint without a new semantic approval.

title: Consequence Slot Term
rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for the source-defined consequence position/function. A slot is not a universal outcome ordering, a severity value or an actual consequence.
context_interpretation: R-40 preserves the original statement's source slot. The inherited documentary identity does not equate identical strings across schemes or force a scalar selection when multiple assertions apply.

title: Risk Register
rationale: Retain collection membership as related information-level context. Riskium adds register scope, purpose and documentary governance without equating the register with an OntoUML collective or physical aggregate.
context_interpretation: RX-008 organizes entry records, while entries and their revisions keep separate identities. Register membership does not establish one-to-one case identity or require every analytical RiskCase to be operationally admitted.

title: Analysis State Term
rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for analysis progress. A value under a declared analysis scheme is not the state of a real-world risk situation or evidence of assessment quality.
context_interpretation: R-31 optionally records analysis state in a RecordStateAssertion. Scheme/version and temporal qualification matter; incomplete or absent state information is not silently replaced by a workflow value or an invented completion result.

title: Workflow State Term
rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for handling/processing status. A workflow label such as Closed does not establish risk cessation, successful treatment or actual authorization.
context_interpretation: R-32 records an optional workflow value; RX-029 and RX-030 link a workflow assignment to its value and scheme version. C-19 preserves unknown rules/authority as unknown. The term resource is not the assignment situation.

title: Record State Assertion
rationale: Retain annotation as related statement/target context. Riskium additionally preserves record aboutness, source and available time precision; no Annotation serialization contract or state-situation equivalence is adopted.
context_interpretation: R-23 attaches the statement to an EntryRevision, R-31/R-32 can retain separate analysis/workflow values, and RX-032 optionally documents a WorkflowAssignment. The statement remains documentary; the assignment remains a situation. Corrections and lineage follow C-03/C-24 without overwriting issued content.
